blurb: Mountain Top Campground is your home away from home near Pittsburgh. Our sites are quiet and spacious, featuring beautiful views of the surrounding countryside. Yet we are just 30 minutes from downtown and all the entertainment and activities of a beautiful and historic city. Our campground is great for RVs, with lots of wide open sites and gravel pads.
